items.headline: Murray kicks 40-yard FG, Howard has game-sealing interception as UL Monroe edges Arkansas State
items.description: — Abram Murray kicked a 40-yard field goal with 1:49 remaining and Gavin Howard had a game-sealing interception with a minute to go as UL Monroe took down Arkansas State 19-17 on Saturday.

items.headline: Trey Owens throws for 2 TDs and runs for 2, leading Arkansas State past Georgia State 38-32
items.description: — Trey Owens threw for two touchdowns and ran for two others, leading Arkansas State to a 38-32 victory over Georgia State on Saturday night in the Red Wolves' homecoming game.
